homeBioParagraphs: Welcome, I’m Idris Olanrewaju IBRAHEEM, a Nigerian cybersecurity researcher, network engineer, and Lecturer in the Department of Mathematical and Computer Sciences (Cybersecurity Unit) at Fountain University, Osogbo. Currently pursuing my Ph.D. in Computer Science at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, my work lives at the intersection of applied Artificial Intelligence, enterprise IT infrastructure, and academic mentorship.

Over the past 15+ years, I have combined hands-on industry operations with university teaching. Before transitioning into my full-time faculty role at Fountain University, I served as a Senior Network Analyst, Network Analyst, IT Officer, and Adjunct Lecturer at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, as well as an Assistant Lecturer at Abdulraheem College of Advanced Studies.

At Fountain University, I lead the Idris Olanrewaju Ibraheem Lab, focusing on practical, explainable, and resilient AI-driven defenses—spanning intrusion detection systems, cloud security, insider threat analytics, and healthcare risk prediction.
academicBioParagraphs: Idris Olanrewaju Ibraheem (born May 14 in Agege, Lagos State; indigenously from Epe LGA, Lagos State) is a Nigerian cybersecurity specialist, network engineer, and academic researcher serving as a Lecturer in the Department of Cybersecurity, College of Computing at Fountain University, Osogbo, Osun State.

He holds an M.Sc. in Computer Science (2022) and a B.Sc. in Computer Science (2019) from Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, alongside an HND (2013) and ND (2010) in Computer Science from Umaru Ali Shinkafi Polytechnic, Sokoto. He is currently completing his Ph.D. in Computer Science at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, investigating the 'Development of a Secure Maternal Health Risk Prediction and Monitoring Model Using LightGBM-SHAP' under Assoc. Prof. Abdulrauf Tosho. In 2022, he won the Departmental Best Innovative M.Sc. Dissertation Prize at Al-Hikmah University.

At Fountain University, he teaches undergraduate courses, leads the Idris Olanrewaju Ibraheem Lab, and serves as Departmental SIWES Coordinator, Member of the Undergraduate Curriculum Committee, Quality Assurance Committee, and College Research & Innovation Committee. Previously, he held dual academic and IT leadership roles at Al-Hikmah University (2017–2025), Abdulraheem College (2020–2025), Kadmus Global Services Abuja (2015–2017), Polio Emergency Operation Center Sokoto (2015), and Usmanu Danfodiyo University Sokoto (2008–2013).
bios.speakerBio: Idris Olanrewaju Ibraheem, is a Nigerian cybersecurity specialist, network engineer, and Lecturer II in the Department of Mathematical and Computer Sciences (Cybersecurity Unit) at Fountain University, Osogbo. Currently a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, he brings over 15 years of combined enterprise IT infrastructure and academic experience to his role. Winner of the 2022 Best Innovative M.Sc. Dissertation Prize, his research applies machine learning and explainable AI to intrusion detection, cloud security, insider threat analytics, and healthcare risk modeling. He holds certifications across Cisco, ISC2, IBM, Microsoft, Fortinet, and MikroTik, and serves as a YALI Community Lead and Hult Prize Volunteer Judge.

teaching.philosophy: Grounded in over a decade of hands-on enterprise network engineering and systems administration, my teaching emphasizes applied, practical defense—bridging core computer science theory with live packet inspection, cloud security labs, ethical hacking simulations, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks.

tracks: Explainable AI (XAI) for Security & Healthcare: Gradient boosting (LightGBM) and SHAP frameworks for transparent predictive modeling in maternal health and enterprise security.
Adversarial & Intrusion Detection Systems: Benchmarking tree-based and deep learning models against evasion attacks, zero-day exploits, and DDoS traffic.
Cloud & Hybrid Network Defense: Unified host-and-network detection architectures (Snort, OSSEC) and protocol vulnerability auditing.
Biometric, Blockchain & FinTech Security: Genetic biometric vulnerabilities, blockchain regulatory compliance frameworks, and AI-driven Islamic finance systems.
mentorshipNotes: Beyond academic theses, I mentor students on SIWES industrial placements, career resilience, and preparation for globally recognized industry certifications.

Drawing on my credentials as a Certified Cybersecurity Educator Professional (CCEP), I guide mentees through certification pathways across Cisco, ISC2, IBM, Microsoft Azure, Fortinet, Google, and MikroTik.
Prospective undergraduate/postgraduate project students and research collaborators are welcome to reach out via ibraheem.idris@fuo.edu.ng with a brief summary of their research interests.

trends.title: Explainable AI moves into high-stakes decisions
body: Clinicians, regulators and security teams increasingly ask why a model made a decision. Tools such as SHAP are becoming part of how models are validated.

trends.title: Adversarial robustness for intrusion detection
body: Detection models are now tested against deliberate evasion, not just clean benchmarks. Comparing tree-based and deep-learning detectors is an active research area.

trends.title: Responsible AI in academic writing
